column1: # Each row defines one active subfamily and its per-subfamily detection thresholds.
#   subfamily            - RepeatMasker repeat name (col 10 of .out), matched against RM_SUBFAMILY
#   class                - RM class: SINE, LINE, or Retroposon
#   confidence           - HIGH or LOW; HIGH = well-established active subfamily
#   min_rm_sv_coverage   - Minimum per-hit RM_SV_COVERAGE fraction for this hit to count
#   Alu:  Konkel MK & Batzer MA (2010) Genome Res; Stewart C et al. (2011) Genome Res
#   L1:   Beck CR et al. (2010) Cell; Brouha B et al. (2003) PNAS
#   SVA:  Wang H et al. (2005) Genome Res; Hancks DC & Kazazian HH (2010) Hum Mutat
